_: arabic-ids.json — the number in each Arabic note's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <vowelled headword> (the alphabet deck: the row's key, a letter or a sign) → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. A note of these decks is one note with two card templates, so both of a word's cards hang off this number (the second card is <id>~2). Seeded on 2026-11-19 from the seven decks as shipped, which run.py, phrases.py and alphabet.py had numbered by position, and APPLIED by arabic-fix.js and build-arabic-alphabet.js: a rebuilt deck is numbered back. NEVER delete or renumber a row — the Update press merges a reader's progress by id. A note the record removes moves to _retired; a new note takes the next free number; a rename renames the key.
